text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, I remember winning 
plushies of Vivlos and Win Variation at an 
arcade a while back.

I intended to hand it over, so it should 
still be in my bag...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Phew. I knew using gold thread here was 
the right choice. It's so sparkly and 
cuuute~♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ehe. Since you gave it to me, Trainie, I 
gotta make a super cute and classy outfit☆

A piece of fabric with beautiful 
embroidery rests on the desk. It still 
seems a ways from completion, but Vivlos's 
work is progressing smoothly.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Shion-san, it's about time for a 
breakâ...hm? What's the matter?

The embroidery placed before Win 
Variation. While it hadn't completely 
fallen apart, you could clearly see how 
much she struggled with it.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I've fixed loose threads and mended things 
before, but I don't really have much 
experience with proper embroidery...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Big siiis. Hey, I have a favor to ask~.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, what is it? If it's anything I can 
help with, just say the word.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...! In that case, leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Huh... Leave it to you?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'll teach you. Don't worry, you'll 
pick it up in no time~♡

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
It feels kind of flat, or rather... really 
two-dimensional, I think...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ah, if so, it might be best to make a base 
with basting first. And then, with a 
straight stitch—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: I-I see...? I'll give it a try...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Aren't the curves of the flower parts 
looking kind of jagged...?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sorry! That was a step I should've 
explained to you right from the start...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
N-No! It's my fault for not noticing. But 
what should we do in this case...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
(Umm, umm. What would Big Sis do at a time 
like this...?)

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ah, right! It might be better to just show 
you... I-I'll give it a try!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
So, next we thread another yarn through 
this stitch, but since it has to be 
wrapped around—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"U-Um, excuse me. Could you do that part 
one more time...? It's hard to tell the 
direction from the front..."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah, that's right. At times like this, 
usually... Ah! Shion-san, could you give 
me a hug?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Why!?

—Training continued after that, but it 
seemed she wasn't able to achieve a 
satisfying result.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: I couldn't teach them properly at aaall...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
If Big Sister taught me, I'd be able to do 
it right away, though...

—That's probably because it's Vivlos, who 
can skillfully pull off almost anything.

Normally, this isn't something you master 
overnight; it takes practice over and over 
again... though she doesn't seem to 
realize that.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
...*sniff*. I wonder if Shion-san got sick 
of it... Did she end up feeling like she 
doesn't wanna do it anymore...?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: "Ugh, Train-y~! What should I do~?!"
choice_data_list: There, there. It's okay, it's okay

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Vivlos-san, look at this!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Whoa, Shion-san?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Even after going back to my room 
yesterday, I kept at it the whole time. 
And then...!

Win Variation unfolded the fabric to show 
me, revealing a stunning, glittering 
embroidery.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...! That's amazing, so amazing. 
You've been doing this all by yourself the 
whole time?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Yes! It's all thanks to Vivlos-san. She 
gave me some tips, and after that I just 
practiced over and over again.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Thank you very much. It might not 
be perfect, but thanks to you, I think 
I'll be able to enjoy the rest of it!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...! Y-You're welcome!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe.

"Want to try your hand at some harder 
embroidery?" Seeing the two of them so 
motivated, I decided to make the 
suggestion.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! ...N-No! You're more than welcome 
to! Since we've come this far, let's go 
all out!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Yeah, yeah, let's do it☆ No matter 
how tough it gets, I'll teach you again♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe.
choice_data_list: If you've been at it all night—

text_block_list.text:
"Why don't you take a short break?" I 
called out to her and decided to brew some 
tea.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ah, thank you very much! ...Whew. It's not 
even finished yet, but I feel such a huge 
sense of accomplishment.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"Vivlos-san. Thank you so much! You're so 
dependable!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
—Fufu! Let's work hard together until it's 
finished♡ I'm sure it'll turn out to be 
the most wonderful outfit ever!
